text:
Rae Kim: Quick sync — Queens LLM Lab pop-up next Wed. We need to finalize speaking slot, swag mix, lead-form flow, and a one-pager for the demo table. Can folks chime in?
Diego Morales: I submitted two talks: 1) quick benchmark teardown, 2) prompt engineering live. Which do we want to feature?
Lina Patel: Benchmarks. Short teardown + a 7-minute live query is the sweet spot. Audience is mostly engineers.
Owen Brooks: Swag numbers — budget approved for 300 tees, 150 stickers, 80 caps. Want the stickers QR-enabled.
SwagBot: PO created RED-2026-189: tees(300), stickers(150), caps(80). Est ship 2026-05-02. Supplier note: caps have 10% longer lead time.
Yara Gomez: Logistics: load-in 16:00, table 8ft, power + 2 chairs. Venue wifi fine but we'll bring a backup hotspot. Who can handle kit transport?
Owen Brooks: I can pick up the box Friday 10:00 from office.
Rae Kim: Lead capture flow — QR -> short form (email, company, role, interest checkbox) -> tag=queens_pop_up -> auto-email to events@redwood.com -> create CRM lead. If company size>1000 tag enterprise and route to AE Enterprise queue.
Diego Morales: Can we add a checkbox to opt into benchmarks follow-up? Helps for benchmark narrative leads.
Lina Patel: Yes. Also we should have a tiny one-pager on table: 3 bullets: 1) p50 100ms, 2) cost $0.38/1k w/ caching, 3) routing Dedicated vs Hosted. Keep it visual.
Rae Kim: Copy notes for one-pager: "Ship LLM features reliably — real infra, real numbers." Add micro-chart for p50/p95.
SwagBot: Supplier alert: 300 tees OK, caps delayed. Recommend priority ship for samples.
EventsBot: Reminder: speaking submission window closes today 18:00. Slots: 17:00 demo, 18:00 panel.
Diego Morales: I'll take 17:00 demo slot if it's still open.
Lina Patel: Please add a 30s recorded snippet to the submission (helps reviewers).
Owen Brooks: I'll assemble a travel kit: laptop stand, HDMI adapter, ethernet dongle, spare battery, USB-C dongles.
Yara Gomez: Badge list: Rae, Diego, Lina, Owen, Yara. I'll order 6x staff lanyards.
Rae Kim: Marketing tasks: Lina - design one-pager + QR card; Owen - bring monitor; Diego - finalize demo script + 2 slides; Yara - badges + venue contact; Rae - lead-form + CRM mapping. Gather mocks by Monday 12:00.
Lina Patel: Will do. Canva link: https://canva.example/redwood/queens-pop-up — sharing mock by Mon 11:00.
Diego Morales: Demo metrics to show: p50 100ms, p95 380ms, tokens/sec 240 (batched), cost $0.38/1k caching. Will include a small note about quantized model variant.
Rae Kim: Also prepping a small webinar follow-up scheduled 2 weeks after the pop-up. Capture leads opt-in and schedule a 30m webinar — topic: "Serving LLMs in production". Draft invite copy after event.
Owen Brooks: Can we have an autoresponder email for signups with a calendar link for webinar?
Rae Kim: Yes — set autoresponder to include calendar invite and a short 1-pager PDF.
SwagBot: Update: expedited sample order placed for caps. New ETA 2026-04-28.
Yara Gomez: Venue confirmed load-out window 19:30. I'll confirm access to a hand truck.
Lina Patel: Design note for stickers: include tiny contrast border so QR scans from phone camera.
Diego Morales: Demo checklist: laptop with local model, API keys (dev account), offline model fallback, hotspot, test dataset, speaker mic.
Owen Brooks: I'll bring the speaker mic and spare HDMI cable.
Rae Kim: Final note: use UTM utm_source=queens_pop_up&utm_campaign=llm_lab_may. QR must map to form with hidden field event=queens_pop_up.
Lina Patel: Mock shared in thread. Need approval for colors and logo placement.
Rae Kim: Approve colors — go ahead with production. Jules (printing) will do badges Tuesday.
EventsBot: Confirmation: raffle item rules posted. Must collect email opt-in for prize entry.
Diego Morales: I'll run the raffle sign-up on the demo table (simple form).
Rae Kim: Great work all. Let's sync Mon 12:30 to finalize assets. :rocket:
